sources.title: @ManniX-ITA on Hugging Face: "opencoti-llamafile — single-file ...
sources.snippet: Since opencoti-llamafile with the PolyKV API knows the actual load on the GPU it can auto-balance with just the right tps floor value for the model, independently of any other instance running or not running in parallel. If there's no other load can scale up the workers up or above the available slots, your decision.

sources.title: Models | OpenCode
sources.snippet: Here the full ID is provider_id/model_id. For example, if you're using OpenCode Zen, you would use opencode/gpt-5.1-codex for GPT 5.1 Codex. If you've configured a custom provider, the provider_id is key from the provider part of your config, and the model_id is the key from provider.models.
